entries.7583b97362b313cf: This is the company's core business division, handling "boneless fish" from which all fish bones have been removed, for medical and nursing-care meals. The company succeeded in developing it in 1998 and holds four manufacturing patents for its processing technology. X-ray inspection for residual bones is carried out, and as of March 2026 it offers 32 fish species. Revenue by business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,713 million.
entries.8918686ed53ed7a7: End users such as medical meal providers, bento caterers and restaurants
entries.cc195f08c5cc6d24: A company that plans commercial frozen foods, including boneless fish, for users such as medical-care meal providers and restaurants, entrusts their manufacture to partner factories, and sells them.
entries.e11ba647b9498f9f: This is a business division handling livestock meat products that apply the processing technology of "boneless fish." The main product is the "Rakuraku Takumi Flavor Series," which can be cooked from frozen and keeps its tenderness even when cold. Revenue by business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,441 million.
